question: Should this repository accept the proposed maintainer-only authority to reconcile Cloudflare Access and publish generation-bound credentials while deployment consumption remains disabled until a separate cutover?
rationale: Automated checks can verify fail-closed mechanics, but they cannot decide whether this production credential authority split and named-operator binding match repository governance.

options.title: Approve staged authority
options.body: Accept the dormant bootstrap after the changelog cleanup, with deployment consumption blocked until a separately reviewed atomic migration.

options.title: Narrow publication authority
options.body: Allow Cloudflare reconciliation but defer cross-repository secret and generation publication until the consumer migration is ready.

options.title: Pause the bootstrap
options.body: Retain manual credential management until reconciliation and deployment authority can be approved as one design.

recommendation.title: Approve staged authority
recommendation.body: Accept the dormant bootstrap after the changelog cleanup, with deployment consumption blocked until a separately reviewed atomic migration.

likelyOwner.reason: The workflow names this member as the sole operator, and the supplied commit trail shows ownership of the staged authority and compatibility design.
